Sara —

Thanks for the quick reply. Friday 18th 08:00–12:00 PT works for our team. I've tentatively blocked the window and shared a Google calendar invite (link below) — please accept when you confirm attendees.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Guardrails example: We typically require a primary JSON schema for structured outputs plus a fallback text pattern. For the workshop we'll bring a 1-page spec that maps prompts -> expected JSON keys (type + required flag) and a small set of validation examples (happy / edge / failed cases).
- Load-test targets: for the POC we suggest a baseline steady-state of 100 RPS for 30 minutes, with 3x surge spikes of 300 RPS for 2 minutes each. Success: 95th percentile token-latency under 350ms (model dependent), <1% server errors, and no KV-cache thrashing observed in logs. We'll run with the routing policy you prefer and capture per-route metrics.

Attachments included: redwood_loadtest_plan.pdf (one-page plan + checklist).
